title: Bee Removal in Larchmont, Westchester
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Larchmont, Westchester. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, eaves, and voids. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Stinging insects in Larchmont — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — build nests in wall voids, soffits, eaves, chimneys, and structural wood that won't resolve on their own. Best Pest Control NYC provides licensed nest treatment and removal for homeowners and businesses throughout this Westchester community. Our technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: With over a decade serving Westchester County, Best Pest Control NYC understands the unique challenges Larchmont properties face with bee infestations. Our team uses eco-friendly methods and arrives quickly to handle bee problems in your home, historic estate, or waterfront property with minimal disruption to your daily routine.
localContext: Larchmont's tree-lined streets, historic manor homes, and proximity to Long Island Sound create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests to establish themselves in eaves, chimneys, wall voids, and garden structures. From the Manor Park neighborhood to properties near Larchmont Manor Beach Club, our technicians are familiar with the area's distinctive architecture and landscape features that commonly attract yellow jackets to attic vents, paper wasps to porch soffits, and carpenter bees to exposed wood trim and railings.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Larchmont?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Larchmont?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Larchmont property?
faqs.answer: We understand that stinging-insect nests can be urgent, especially if family members are allergic. We typically offer same-day or next-day service in Larchmont. Most nest treatments are completed within 2–4 hours, depending on nest size and location. We seal entry points to prevent recolonization after the nest is treated and removed.

faqs.question: How do you approach treatments where children and pets live?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-registered products applied directly to the nest, and we explain the products used and re-entry timing on site. Residents and pets should remain indoors during the treatment as a precaution. Once treated areas are dry and we confirm re-entry timing, your family and pets can return. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
